title: ask-command-cheatsheet
desc: wkappbot ask command cheatsheet: claude/gpt/gemini/triad dispatch, CDP port isolation, cdp field in grap, eval replacement with --eval-js.
steps: ask triad 'question' -- dispatch to AI tab via CDP. Each runs against the project's Chrome (cdp={port} profile)
CDP isolation: each project has own Chrome in chrome-profiles/cdp={port}/. Ask NEVER touches another project's Chrome
cdp open URL -> returns OK {proc:'chrome',...,cdp:9222}. Use this grap for subsequent a11y commands to pin port
a11y eval REMOVED -- use a11y read/find/click with --eval-js 'expr' instead
a11y find '{proc:chrome,cdp:9222}' -- only finds Chrome on port 9222, personal Chrome excluded

--new-tab flag: NOW FUNCTIONAL -- clears registry entry for the sandbox key, forcing GetOrCreateSandboxedTabAsync to create a fresh tab instead of reusing cache. Use when tab is stuck or needs fresh session.

Tab cap=9: enforced immediately on every ask entry (EnforceTabCapAsync fire-and-forget). LRU tab closed when >9 registered. Idle tabs (>5min) recycled first: ping(1s) + Page.navigate to base URL -- if ping fails (renderer dead/dialog blocking) tab is killed and new tab allowed.
[CDP:DIALOG:BLOCKED] red log + wkappbot speak when JS alert/confirm/beforeunload blocks a11y commands. Auto-dismissed via Page.handleJavaScriptDialog. All blocked commands resume automatically.
[CDP:NODE-ERROR] red log when 'No node'/'Cannot find context'/'detached' errors occur. Dumps: URL, title, readyState, dialog nodes, top-8 interactive targets with selectors for retargeting.

Triad dialog recovery: if one of 3 parallel asks has a JS alert -- only that tab blocks (others continue). EvalAsync detects recent dialog dismiss (within 5s) and retries once after 300ms delay. Gives 3/3 triad results instead of 2/3 partial.
author: claude
